content_sections.heading: DCBH Junior Resident Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the DCBH Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. content_sections.text: Junior Resident: MBBS Degree from a recognized University/Institution and must possess valid Registration Certificate from DMC

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: All Posts: Maximum age limit is 30 years. Age relaxation is applicable: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (Delhi only).

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Junior Resident: Rs. 56100/- as per 7th CPC level 10 plus allowances

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DCBH Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Deep Chand Bandhu Hospital (DCBH) in Delhi for filling up Junior Resident positions on an ad-hoc basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available for the Junior Resident post under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for DCBH Junior Resident?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree from a recognized University or Institution along with a valid Registration Certificate from the Delhi Medical Council (DMC).

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Resident positions involves a direct Walk-in Interview followed by document verification on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Junior Resident position is scheduled to be held on 01-10-2026 at the designated hospital premises.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for general candidates?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for general category candidates applying for the Junior Resident post is 30 years as per the official recruitment rules.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any age relaxation applicable for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided as per government guidelines: 5 years of relaxation for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates from Delhi.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for DCBH Junior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories; it is completely Nil.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for the Junior Resident post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 56,100/- as per the 7th CPC Level 10, plus admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original educational certificates, MBBS degree, valid DMC registration, ID proof, category certificate, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.
